satellite.description: index into properties.satellites; a satellite has several tracks because tracks are cut at the antimeridian

swathKm.description: nominal imaging swath, 0 when not an Earth observation satellite

properties.projection: longitude/latitude degrees; split at the antimeridian with interpolated crossing vertices at exactly +-180
properties.source: CelesTrak GP element sets (TLE), SGP4 via satellite.js
